$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-09-15 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report 1aad0e8f. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v38 index for sub2api (INDEX 9195c109) built by publish-tee-images run 34951748126 from commit 12316f12a; the attestor image is deliberately left at its proof-v20 pin because deploy/attestor carries no change since that release, and repinning it would change composeHash for no reason. NOTE: the amd64 child must be read from `imagetools inspect --raw` and matched on platform — the index also carries an unknown/unknown attestation-manifest child (889892c7 for this index), which is NOT runnable; pinning it once took production down.
